samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO, FIFO bit width and depth can be configured(parameter DEPTH = 16, parameter WIDTH = 8).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data to be written into the FIFO.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data read from the FIFO.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth, default value is 16.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">FIFO bit width, default value is 8.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>
        <!-- Dual-port RAM instance -->
        <instance id="ram" module="dual_port_RAM">
            <connection id="wclk">wclk</connection>
            <connection id="rclk">rclk</connection>
            <connection id="wen">wen</connection>
            <connection id="ren">ren</connection>
            <connection id="waddr">waddr</connection>
            <connection id="raddr">raddr</connection>
            <connection id="wdata">wdata</connection>
            <connection id="rdata">rdata</connection>
        </instance>
        
        <!-- Write and read pointers -->
        <reg id="waddr_bin" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Binary representation of write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Binary representation of read pointer.</reg>
        <wire id="wen">Write enable signal for RAM.</wire>
        <wire id="ren">Read enable signal for RAM.</wire>
        <wire id="waddr">Address for writing data into RAM.</wire>
        <wire id="raddr">Address for reading data from RAM.</wire>
        <wire id="wdata">Data to be written into RAM.</wire>
        <reg id="wptr" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Gray code representation of write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Gray code representation of read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Buffer register for write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Buffer register for read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_syn" type="sequential_logic" init_value="0">Synchronized read pointer.</reg>
        <assign wen = (winc && !wfull);
        <assign ren = (rinc && !rempty);
        <assign waddr = waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        <assign raddr = raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        <assign wdata = wdata;
        <assign rdata = rdata;
        // Write pointer logic
        <always id="write_pointer_logic" sensitivity="posedge wclk or negedge wrstn">
            <if condition="!wrstn">
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            </if>
            else begin
                if (winc && !wfull) begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                    wptr <= {wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0], ~(^wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0])};
                end
            end
        </endalways>
        // Read pointer logic
        <always id="read_pointer_logic" sensitivity="posedge rclk or negedge rrstn">
            <if condition="!rrstn">
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            </if>
            else begin
                if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                    rptr <= {rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0], ~(^rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0])};
                end
            end
        </endalways>
        // Buffer registers for write pointer
        <always id="buffer_write_pointer" sensitivity="posedge wclk or negedge wrstn">
            <if condition="!wrstn">
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            </if>
            else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        </endalways>
        // Buffer registers for read pointer
        <always id="buffer_read_pointer" sensitivity="posedge rclk or negedge rrstn">
            <if condition="!rrstn">
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            </if>
            else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        </endalways>
        // Synchronize read pointer
        <always id="synchronize_read_pointer" sensitivity="posedge wclk or negedge wrstn">
            <if condition="!wrstn">
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            </if>
            else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        </endalways>
        // Full and empty flags
        <assign wfull = (({~wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]} == rptr_syn));
        <assign rempty = (rptr_syn == wptr);
    </implementation>
</module>
